sloka: दिवः क्षिप्तामिवोल्कां तां शक्तिं क्षिप्तामसङ्गताम्।गृहीत्वा हरिशार्दूलो बभञ्ज च ननाद च ।। ६.७०.३९ ।।
transliteration: divaḥ kṣiptāmivolkāṁ tāṁ śaktiṁ kṣiptāmasaṅgatām।gṛhītvā hariśārdūlo babhañja ca nanāda ca ।। 6.70.39 ।।

translations.english: Hanuman, the best of monkeys, snapped the javelin flung by Trisira on him, which came down unobstructed like a meteor from heaven and the monkeys roared.
